reviews.classification: complete presentation/fourth-wall palette, explicit knowledge corrections and later bounded delivery history
reviews.disposition:
All 2,358 input lines were read in fourteen contiguous bounded ranges, including X1–X7/P1–P7, the M/R reach tables, SP1–SP8/L1–L11, every unnumbered power/collision/family example, TX1–TX13, ON1–ON8/PGR1–PGR8, ID/BL/BF/KN/AB/VP/IN/EK and IM tables, the explicit enemy-knowledge corrections and all Corc/credit/title addenda. These remain a palette with dated implementation statements, not an effects catalogue already installed or a new default taxonomy. Renamed PGR codes avoid collision with registered generation GR; local code names do not acquire global rule authority.

The strongest retained distinctions are useful: ordinary effects can stay quiet; text/world consequences can matter without an animation; a signature can have a static plain form; known event, viewer, logical subject and actual consumer determine presentation; skipping or reopening an effect does not settle rewards again. Ordinary little physical scenes and atmosphere need not be earned fourth-wall powers. Restraint, size/intensity ladders, first-use decay, family motifs, one-effect-per-line and per-world budgets are authoring dials. A powerful event can be plain or an ordinary moment expressive for a fitting reason; numeric spectacle is not a power hierarchy. Saved cosmetic marks/options still have actual persistence ownership even if the transient animation has none.

Later user direction explicitly narrows earlier universal dossier, KN-ladder and disclosure examples. Ordinary enemies retain what they actually saw/heard/remembered; organizations, appraisers, regressors, systems and other record-keepers can have richer records through actual means. The player likewise has no automatic appraisal simply by entering a status-window world. Viewpoint-filtered text, plain fallback, screen-reader labels, copy text and summaries must not expose a different hidden truth or a secret identity. A harmless-sounding source motif, unknown-slot count, redaction length, pulse outside a sensing radius, source color or exact failed-appraisal rung can itself leak information unless the observer's means supports it. An NPC's inner belief/dossier is not freely visible because the engine stores it. Current AD8 separately keeps the player's own stats exact; this file's earlier own-numbers-require-an-in-world-status-window paragraph is historical where it conflicts. In-fiction self-sensation can still be described separately.

The early statement that every bluff has an observable tell is not universal law. The same palette later allows perfect illusion with no wrong letter and an unrevealed trump card with no tell until use. A false weakness need not be visibly suspicious merely because it was cheap to learn; a better deception may be indistinguishable to current means. Suspicion, identification, source attribution, confidence and actual truth can differ. Rarity/fame/prior knowledge make a specific impersonation plausible or implausible locally, not prohibited by a fixed famous-name permission list. A witness's existence alone does not instantly train every rival, spread information everywhere or guarantee a learning gain; actual communication, capability and cause remain necessary. Perfectly fitting appraisal may also know exactly rather than being forcibly uncertain.

The named franchise techniques are memory-led design illustrations, not paragraph-qualified mechanics or runnable state transitions. In particular, stalled Infinity damage accumulating and later all landing, no-energy bypass, universal domain sure-hit, adaptation reset by damage type, resurrection wording, cloned memories, title recognition and automatic economic/witness reactions need their actual source/world mechanism before use. A common barrier drawing does not make every world's barrier mechanic identical. Procedural rendering, a composed shot list and generated gameplay are different meanings of generated. The arithmetic illustration is internally wrong: 340 raised to 2.5 is approximately 2,131,558.68, not 62,000 (task-local arithmetic receipt retained). This calculation does not certify a franchise formula or units; preserve the old example as history and select a qualified normalized formula before a real readout uses it.

Cosmetic shatter, hidden controls, deceptive text, real blindness/silence and actual game-state loss are different mechanisms. Ordinary input/focus must remain usable when a decorative layer is disabled; a genuine world effect can change available information or agency through its actual owner rather than CSS alone. The Cat blocking input, Trickster hiding Save, moving scrollbar/targets and first-hover refusal are tension points with the later stable-target/plain-access rules, not automatically approved exceptions. A fake crash/deletion is presentation, never permission to alter personal files or saves. Notification/clipboard/export suggestions retain direct player action and actual route authority, not a standing permission request from the document. Playing in Electron or the web under AD39 changes the host affordances; it does not grant fictional characters personal-data access.

The event-driven registry, overlay/shot list, glyph fallback, grapheme handling, localization, lifetime cleanup and hidden-tab suppression are useful implementation ideas tied to selected consumers. Timing must distinguish simulation, supported reaction window, cosmetic clock and real time: hit-stop, sound stretch, skip, replay or a return reel cannot change a settled result or advance a paused world. A cue on a hidden log group should not replay when exposed; actual return summaries keep their knowledge/event-time scope. Old Arial, source line numbers, DOM caps, no-aria-live, HackTimer and synchronous native XP observations are dated inspections rather than fresh runtime facts. Rough concurrent-effect counts or a flash-frequency number do not establish accessibility compliance; the selected visual needs its actual contrast/area/motion/interaction evidence. No WebGL, audio library, clip-path or universal fx API is selected by retaining these notes. Historical license/rights/hardware/source claims are recorded evidence and require exact source/asset verification for any later adoption; they were not rechecked on the web here.

The October13 Proto23 section records a bounded known-skill signature/settings consumer and retains transactional versus native XP publication timing; it does not deliver every proposed power, gallery or returning reel. Later Corc additions keep subject identity through reflow, known static meaning, appropriate bodies/means, affectionate callbacks and mastery without forced spectacle. Effects-off does not replay old discoveries or erase useful outcomes. Title display/worn selection differs from passive learned competence, conditional opportunity and actual activated use; an additional real reward may coexist under SLR43. The launch/credit chronology explicitly supersedes the early generated SVG and mistaken aviator asset with the exact user-edited PNG derivative, preserving source-author identities and the unverified source-project Ko-fi gap. Those are dated delivery statements, not current asset/link/browser verification. AD42 makes human review optional rather than a blocker; current UI_RULES desktop targets govern any selected slice.

Use current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), [means/appraisal](MEANS_AND_APPRAISAL.md) and the actual gameplay/settlement/knowledge owners. Keep the reference staging, quiet expressive details, static alternatives, explicit corrections and useful history. No effect, ability, audio, host permission, asset replacement, product rule, gameplay result, source qualification or present runtime proof is created by this reconciliation.
reviews.evidence: Actual full2358line reading in contiguous ranges1–170 through2211–2358. Actual RULES_INDEX AD6–8/AD42 checked and arithmetic computed in presentation-arithmetic-b435.json. No linked source jar, franchise paragraph, current runtime, browser, asset, personal data or external license/page newly verified.
reviews.reopen: Keep actual observer/own-stat authority, source mechanism, input/subject lifetime and settled-event boundaries; later selected work needs relevant qualified source and real desktop/persistence proof. Preserve original examples as history.
